options.title: Quiet oak
options.description: Pale oak, warm limestone and soft ivory.
options.style: Pale natural oak flat-front cabinetry with fine vertical grain, creamy honed limestone worktops, off-white plaster walls, warm limestone large-format floor, sculptural off-white linen dining chairs, pale solid oak rounded dining table, restrained opal pendant lights. Modern, calm and warm. An elegant monolithic island for Proposed; a rounded dining table for Planning.

options.title: Walnut & bronze
options.description: Rich timber with warm stone and bronze details.
options.style: Rich straight-grain walnut flat-panel cabinetry, pale warm quartzite counters, brushed bronze taps and slender lighting, warm ivory walls, pale stone floor. Soft tan leather upholstered slim dining chairs and an oval walnut table. Beautiful warm modern architecture, subtle grain, refined not ostentatious.

options.title: Soft sculpted ivory
options.description: Rounded edges, tonal stone and tactile upholstery.
options.style: Matte ivory handleless cabinets, gently rounded end panels and worktop corners, creamy travertine-style porcelain counters and floor, warm white plaster. Elegant cream textured dining chairs, rounded pale stone dining table, one restrained sculptural pendant. Monolithic and soft, carefully detailed, no excessive arches or curves.

options.title: Charcoal & natural oak
options.description: A bold kitchen balanced by pale wood and daylight.
options.style: Deep charcoal matte handleless cabinetry with natural oak end panels and tall storage accents, thin pale porcelain counters, pale oak plank flooring, warm white walls, black slim lighting. A natural oak dining table and comfortable cream upholstered chairs. Architectural modern, strong contrast, bright daytime not moody darkness.

options.title: Sage & cream
options.description: Muted green cabinetry with a warm, garden-led palette.
options.style: Muted grey-sage matte flat-panel cabinets, creamy porcelain worktops, warm light oak floor, subtle brushed brass hardware, warm white plaster. Rounded light-oak dining table, sage linen seat pads and pale timber chairs. Minimal modern pendant with soft opal glass, sophisticated botanical calm, very restrained greenery.

options.title: Stone & smoked oak
options.description: Smoky timber, greige stone and a quiet linear layout.
options.style: Smoked oak flat-front cabinetry, greige porcelain stone slab worktops, large light greige stone floor, bone-white walls, gunmetal taps, slim linear dark-bronze pendant. A smoked oak oval dining table with cognac upholstered slim chairs. Restrained contemporary European architecture, precise detailing.

options.title: Warm stainless
options.description: Brushed metal softened by timber and warm textiles.
options.style: Brushed stainless steel lower cabinetry and counters balanced by warm pale oak tall cabinetry and island end panels, warm off-white walls, light oak floor. A pale timber rounded dining table, cream wool upholstered chairs, slim aluminium pendant. Refined modern residential kitchen, softly reflective metal not commercial restaurant, tactile cosy dining.

options.title: Clay & light oak
options.description: Earthy colour with delicate timber and soft lighting.
options.style: Soft muted clay-beige handleless cabinets, pale warm ivory stone counters, light natural oak details and flooring, warm off-white walls. Light oak rounded dining table and warm terracotta fabric chairs, a simple cream ceramic pendant. Warm highly modern, tasteful colour, restrained earthy textures, no rustic or country styling.

options.title: Midnight & marble
options.description: Deep blue cabinetry with restrained veining and brass.
options.style: Deep midnight navy flat-panel cabinets, subtle white marble-look porcelain countertops with restrained grey veining, slim brushed brass details, pale limestone tile floor, soft white walls. Dark walnut oval dining table, cream upholstered dining chairs, elegant thin brass and opal pendant. Modern tailored luxury, not ornate or excessively glossy.

options.title: Sand & ribbed glass
options.description: Sand-toned cabinetry, reeded glass and soft black accents.
options.style: Warm sand matte slab cabinets, pale sandy stone worktops and floor, one refined reeded-glass upper storage panel at the existing tall cabinet zone, natural oak touches, soft black taps. Rounded sand-toned dining table, pale oak and cream upholstered chairs, simple translucent glass pendants. Light, layered, modern and exceptionally refined.
